main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x excess 2-bar forward return on settlement bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Welch t of forecast-signed excess 2-bar return, top third minus bottom third by |forecast|

decided_by: The main mean is positive with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom third Welch t is >= 2.
reading: The coin's mean 2-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 2, 4, ...) of each window pooled over its windows, settlement bars without a full 2-bar forward return in their window are left out, and the thirds are the pooled cases sorted by |forecast| split into floor(n/3) bottom and top with the remainder in the middle, all three needing 300.
